M000317.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
M000317.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
M000317.note: None of this member's itemized donors work in the industries of this bill's lobbying clients.
